write.crisisBody: There are places you can talk to right now. You can keep writing this request.
write.wordsTip: Before anything goes to AI, we hide what looks like names and contact details. Supporters only see your nickname and this text. You can write in any language; we keep the original and supporters can also see a translation.
write.noPersonalInfo: Please don't write your name, phone number or address
write.wish: What would you like to happen?
write.sendNeedsWords: Write at least a few words to send
write.sendFailed: We couldn't send it. Please try again.
write.activeLimit: You can have up to 3 open requests. Cancel or close one first.
write.dailyLimit: You've sent many requests in a short time. Please wait a little.
write.wordsTitleOrg: What is your organization struggling with?
write.suggestTitle: If any of these fit, pick them
write.suggestLead: Based on what you wrote, these look close. You can pick up to 3.
write.suggestNone: We could not find close matches. You can also look below.
write.noneIsOkSend: If nothing fits, you can send without picking.

org.leadCompany: The request belongs to the company and other members can see it. It continues even if the person in charge changes.
org.leadCommunity: The request belongs to the local government section or neighborhood group, and other members can see it. A successor can take over.
org.which: Which organization are you asking for?
org.registerTip: This name is shown as the organization asking for help. Your nickname is not shown. The samasama team will check the registration later.
org.communityName: Organization name (e.g. a city section or neighborhood group)
org.residents: Number of people living in the area
org.registerFailed: We couldn't register it. Please try again.

thread.label: Messages
thread.closed: This conversation has ended. You can still read it.

system.resolvedConfirmed: The person who asked confirmed it is solved
system.resolvedNotYet: The person who asked said it is not solved yet
system.resolveReported: A supporter reported that it is solved
system.autoResolved: It was marked solved automatically 14 days after the report
system.autoClosed: This request was closed after 30 days without activity

case.deliveredLead: It has reached supporters who fit. Offers will appear here.
case.deliveredTip: Only your nickname and what you wrote are visible. We don't have your name or contact details.
case.deliveredTipMinor: Requests from people under 18 go only to organizations we have interviewed. Only your nickname and what you wrote are visible.
case.notifyMe: Let me know when an offer arrives
case.cancelConfirm: If you cancel, you won't receive offers anymore. Cancel it?
case.nextOpen: Waiting for offers from supporters. Meanwhile, you can also contact the services nearby below.

offers.tip: The first one you choose leads the support. If you pass, they are not told why.
offers.invitedBy: Suggested by {name}. They join if you agree
offers.chosenLead: Chosen. They will lead the support
offers.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

resolve.title: A supporter says it is solved
resolve.lead: If your problem is solved, please confirm. If not, you can say so.
resolve.failed: Something went wrong. Please try again.

referrals.title: While you wait: services nearby
referrals.tip: If you choose "Ask the team to pass it on", the samasama team will contact the service through its reception (phone or form) and share only your nickname and what you wrote. We never send emails automatically.
referrals.okToShare: Ask the team to pass it on
referrals.agreed: The team will pass it on

talk.title: Messages
talk.empty: You're not working with a supporter yet.

handover.title: Enter a handover code
handover.lead: Enter the code you received from an organization to make the request they registered for you your own.
handover.wrong: The code is wrong or has expired
handover.rateLimit: Too many wrong codes. Please wait a little
